choice_data_list: You're full of energy this morning!
You're full of energy this morning!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Yesterday, I had a nice, long chat 
over a LANE call with my father in France!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Things like the differences in trends 
between Japan and France, or shops we used 
to visit together in Paris back then— 
Ahaha, it's really just lighthearted 
chit-chat!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Talking to you about it made me feel so 
relieved... I slept shockingly well♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel enjoyed a fulfilling break 
and seems to be fully recharged!
